items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: The interviewer asks 'So how does Bolton fit into this?' but the interviewee does not mention Bolton in his response, instead narrating a story about Frank Deucin, John Shailis, and a band featuring Ned, Frank Lewis, Jimmy Phillips, and Ike.

ctx.x: You heard of the kick, got it? Sure. They had all kinds of excitements. When the band would make a break and all that. Well, they'd come there with paper bags. Blow the bags up. The band would make a break. Boom! How did the bags go? They have a bar in there? Huh? A bar in there? Oh, sure a bar. What? They had all kinds of stuff in there. All the kinds of wines in the world in there.
So how does Bolton fit into this?

Now, let me show you. Well, Frank Deucin. I was a kid, right to separation from the hall to my house, in a big picket fence. So I and a bunch of boys hanging around the corner. How old were you? Huh? Oh, around about 12. So, me living next to the hall. The fellow used to run it. Called him, uh, John Shailis. He was a manager. So I'd ask him. I said, John said, let me sweep up the hall. All right, you sweep up the hall. And in the night time, he'd leave me going in the hall. So I'd take him down about two or three…
